evidence.observation: Pressure 3.018 Torr at start of growth, matching the steady ~3.00±0.02 Torr seen during the ramp
Pressure has risen steadily to 3.509 Torr (about +0.5 Torr in 12 min), roughly 25 times the normal noise
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm, so the pressure rise is not caused by more gas going in
Temperature holding at 750 °C with normal heater power, so the thermal side looks fine
No exhaust O2 sensor is installed, so I can't check the atmosphere or tell a seal leak (air coming in) from an exhaust blockage

args.missing_evidence: An O2 or residual-gas reading of the exhaust, or a rate-of-rise / leak-check test with the flow stopped (or a check of the exhaust line and pump), would show whether this is air leaking in or the exhaust being restricted.
